_meaning: m[0..11] = typical CHEAP round-trip fare for that month, in USD. Not an average fare — the board compares live fares against what a good price normally looks like. Every route carries the source of its level in `src`; ESTIMATE routes must stay labelled as estimates wherever they are shown.
